title: A Rivergate for the Landfall
author: Tamsin Zhou
blurb: Isandro Coldharbour, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
